name: Parallel-SSHI-FBR-Zener
rationale: The reference FBR fails on low-excitation (S4) and heavy-load (S2) conditions because the open-circuit voltage is low and diode drops are significant. I am adding a Parallel SSHI (Synchronous Switch Harvesting on Inductor) circuit to invert the piezoelectric capacitor's charge at each voltage extremum, significantly increasing the extracted power. To prevent overvoltage in S3, a DZ33 zener clamp is added to the output. This combination should raise vavg for S2/S4 and limit vmax/ripple for S3.
